meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后，你可以选择让Claude使用Codex（OpenAI的代码应用服务器）作为完整的代理提供者，而非默认的Claude。Codex负责规划、工具调用、MCP工具支持、服务端对话历史与恢复。
howto.when: 当你对某个群组运行`ncl groups config update --provider codex`命令，或设置新群组默认使用Codex后，该群组的下一轮对话将使用Codex。

say.text: 帮我将群组A切换到Codex提供商。
say.note: Claude会执行切换命令，重启后生效。
Claude会验证安装步骤并报告结果。
Claude会询问后执行相应操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can choose to use Codex (OpenAI's code app-server) as the full agent provider for a group instead of Claude. Codex handles planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side conversation history, and session resume.
howto.when_en: When you run `ncl groups config update --provider codex` for a group, or set the default for new groups, the next conversation in that group uses Codex.

say_en.text: Switch group A to the Codex provider.
say_en.note: Claude executes the switch and restarts.

say_en.text: Set default provider to Codex for new groups.
say_en.note: Claude asks for confirmation then applies.
